description: Chapter summaries the reader shows under a chapter's title, keyed by chapter number, per language. Like section headings they are editorial aids, not translation: written from Open Word Bible's own wording, stating what the chapter is about and nothing more, so every language can say the same thing. They use no reader settings. Every summary is an AI draft until a named reviewer approves it.

1.en: Paul thanks God for the Philippians' partnership in the gospel and prays that their love may grow. His chains have moved the gospel forward, for him to live is Jesus and to die is gain, and he urges them to live worthy of the gospel.
1.sw: Paulo anamshukuru Mungu kwa ushirika wa Wafilipi katika Injili na kuomba upendo wao uzidi kukua. Minyororo yake imeisogeza Injili mbele, kwa maana kwake kuishi ni Yesu na kufa ni faida, naye anawahimiza waishi kwa namna inayostahili Injili.
1.am: ጳውሎስ የፊልጵስዩስ ሰዎች በወንጌል ስላላቸው ተካፋይነት እግዚአብሔርን ያመሰግናል፤ ፍቅራቸውም እንዲያድግ ይጸልያል። እስራቱ ወንጌልን ወደ ፊት አራምዶታል፤ ለእርሱ መኖር ኢየሱስ ነው፤ መሞትም ትርፍ ነው፤ ለወንጌል በሚገባ እንዲኖሩም ያበረታታቸዋል።

2.en: Paul urges the Philippians to think the way Jesus thought: Jesus took the form of a servant, was obedient to death on a cross, and was exalted by God. They are to shine like stars, and Paul plans to send Timothy and Epaphroditus to them.
2.sw: Paulo anawasihi Wafilipi wawaze kama Yesu alivyowaza: Yesu alichukua namna ya mtumishi, akatii hadi kufa msalabani, naye Mungu akamtukuza. Wanapaswa kung'aa kama nyota, naye Paulo anapanga kuwatuma Timotheo na Epafrodito kwao.
2.am: ጳውሎስ የፊልጵስዩስ ሰዎች ኢየሱስ ያሰበውን እንዲያስቡ ይማጸናቸዋል፤ ኢየሱስ የአገልጋይን መልክ ያዘ፣ በመስቀል ላይ እስከ መሞት ድረስ ታዘዘ፣ እግዚአብሔርም ከፍ ከፍ አደረገው። እንደ ከዋክብት ሊያበሩ ይገባቸዋል፤ ጳውሎስም ጢሞቴዎስንና አፍሮዲጡን ወደ እነርሱ ለመላክ ያቅዳል።

3.en: Paul has every reason for confidence in the flesh but counts it all loss compared with knowing Jesus. He presses on toward the goal, for their citizenship is in heaven.
3.sw: Paulo ana kila sababu ya kujiamini katika mwili lakini anahesabu yote kuwa hasara akilinganisha na kumjua Yesu. Anakaza mwendo kuelekea lengo, kwa maana uraia wao uko mbinguni.
3.am: ጳውሎስ በሥጋ ለመታመን ምክንያት ሁሉ አለው፤ ኢየሱስን ከማወቅ ጋር ሲያነጻጽረው ግን ሁሉን እንደ ጕዳት ይቈጥረዋል። ዜግነታቸው በሰማይ ስለ ሆነ ወደ ግቡ ይገሠግሣል።

4.en: Paul urges them to stand firm, to rejoice in the Lord always and to bring every need to God in prayer. He thanks them for their gift, says he has learned to be content in all circumstances, and sends final greetings.
4.sw: Paulo anawahimiza wasimame imara, wafurahi katika Bwana siku zote na kumpelekea Mungu kila hitaji kwa maombi. Anawashukuru kwa zawadi yao, anasema amejifunza kuridhika katika hali zote, na kutuma salamu za mwisho.
4.am: ጳውሎስ ጸንተው እንዲቆሙ፣ ሁልጊዜ በጌታ ደስ እንዲላቸውና ፍላጎታቸውን ሁሉ በጸሎት ወደ እግዚአብሔር እንዲያቀርቡ ያበረታታቸዋል። ስለ ስጦታቸው ያመሰግናቸዋል፤ በማንኛውም ሁኔታ መርካትን እንደ ተማረ ይናገራል፤ የመጨረሻ ሰላምታም ይልካል።
